basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer hailing from Portland, Oregon, with a penchant for mystery games and a love for cozy atmospheres. When I'm not designing, you'll find me exploring the world of Nancy Drew games or unwinding with some furry artwork. I'm in a long-term relationship, and we both enjoy collecting wigs for cosplay events. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work, and I often browse Reddit to relax. I have a soft spot for digital art and am always on the lookout for new inspiration.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in visual arts, having graduated with a degree in Graphic Design. My interest in digital art and gaming led me to explore various genres, especially mystery games like Nancy Drew. I've been a self-taught artist in the furry community, where I frequently exchange ideas and artwork with fellow enthusiasts.
